sources: Flare 2.0 新动作清单 2026-11-20（Google 表 1njBhCNMs-iliNbt3gKxDwCZnpQBxQoi-yPFRGQHmJwk，P0 地板/垫高团身 L 撑（本条为垫高版：手垫瑜伽砖））

purpose.zh: 练直臂把身体撑离地面和收腹抬腿，L 撑的入门
purpose.en: Builds straight-arm support and the hip-flexor/ab tuck; the entry step to the L-sit.

text.zh: 手臂锁直，把砖往下推，膝盖收到胸前
text.en: Arms locked, push the blocks down, knees to your chest

text.zh: 手掌平放在身体两侧的瑜伽砖（或厚书）上，手指朝前。
text.en: Palms flat on yoga blocks (or thick books) beside your hips, fingers forward.

text.zh: 肩往下压，先把屁股撑离地，再把两脚抬起来。
text.en: Press your shoulders down, lift your hips first, then your feet.

text.zh: 脚抬不起来先抬一只脚，另一只脚尖点地。
text.en: If both feet will not come up, lift one and keep the other toe on the floor.

commonErrors.en: Lifting only the legs while the hips stay on the floor.

cautions.zh: 手腕疼就停；砖要放稳不滑
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists hurt; make sure the blocks cannot slide.

flare2.item: P0 地板/垫高团身 L 撑（本条为垫高版：手垫瑜伽砖）
flare2.plans: 4 个计划（阶段 9 中级；腹直肌/髂腰肌/背阔肌中级）
flare2.camera: 右前方 48°（看得到砖、臀离地、膝收胸前）
flare2.doseBrief: 表内未给剂量；草稿按 3 组 × 10 秒、休 60 秒
flare2.note: Animation (r1): hands on 10 cm cork blocks; seated -> arms lock and shoulders press down (hips 14 cm off the mat) -> knees to chest, feet 3.4 cm off -> hold ~4.3 s -> feet and hips down. Home version with blocks only; the floor version (no blocks) is not drawn.

set.zh: 手臂锁直，肩往下压，膝盖收到胸前
set.en: Arms locked, shoulders down, knees to your chest
